blocks.label: Current Beat
blocks.body: The road feels watched. A branch snaps where no wind moved it. The hybrid animals have gone quiet: lark-moths, fox-bats, all of them holding their breath the way you are holding yours. Something is keeping pace with you in the brush, and it is not an animal.

blocks.label: Public Objective
blocks.body: Notice the threat before it reaches you.

affordances: Ask one practical question before acting.
